verdict.rationale: Vapi's speech-configuration docs say developers can 'control exactly when your assistant starts and stops speaking during a conversation,' which points to configurable turn-taking that would cover stopping speech on interruption. Nothing in the pack explicitly describes barge-in, so this is only a thin, indirect mention. missing for 10: explicit barge-in/interruption documentation, evidence of updating conversation context after an interruption, turn-recovery behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of interruption handling.
